scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run test:artifacts && npm run test:e2e
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p config/tsconfig/extension.json --noEmit && tsc -p config/tsconfig/tools.json --noEmit && tsc -p config/tsconfig/tests.json --noEmit && tsc -p config/tsconfig/playwright.json --noEmit
scripts.screenshots: npm run build && npx playwright test --config config/playwright.screenshots.config.ts && npm run screenshots:store
